findings.title: 正常资料被多层固定wire/诊断体积门否决
findings.condition: legitimate canonical selected material/summary or optional diagnostic tree crosses one independent fixed length/count/depth cap after source work succeeded
findings.effect: ContractSizeError/strict contract error -> RESULT_TOO_LARGE/INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID or transport blocked; valid source bytes/results disappear from operation
findings.root_cause: representation and optional diagnostics treated as additional execution permission, independent from configured work/storage/model budget
findings.change: remove fixed successful result/receipt serialization vetoes; stream writes, de-duplicate optional metadata; separate optional diagnostics schema from material support; retain strict ID/ref/type/finite-number and actual configured resource limits
findings.tests: split test_select_handler_cap_and_path_leak_fail_with_zero_effect: oversized valid source now success unchanged; path/source-invalid still reject. Migrate reading_context oversized-only cases to full material preserved, optional trace compacted with counts/hash; hostile cyclic/nonfinite/malformed JSON remain explicit encoding diagnostics and do not invent support.

findings.title: 自动缓存候选损坏成为新任务全局停止条件
findings.condition: during fresh automatic reuse discovery, a matching derived artifact candidate has malformed metadata or invalid generated artifact; reader source remains independently valid
findings.effect: reading_candidate_manifest/read_reuse_pin exception -> BATCH_REUSE_ARTIFACT_INVALID and whole preflight fails before a replacement generation; refresh can still enter discovery when pointer.exists()
findings.root_cause: disposable cache observation has authority to deny source-owned regeneration; corrupt candidate and explicitly pinned immutable result share failure policy
findings.change: automatic candidate discovery records corrupt/stale candidate diagnostic and continues next candidate; if none, perform one current source verification/selection and regenerate under actual existing budget. Explicit requested pin/same-run frozen binding and original-source hash failure still reject; do not silently reuse corrupt output or replay an uncertain paid reservation
findings.tests: keep test_matching_artifact_metadata_corruption_is_an_error_not_spend_permission at strict candidate parser, but add discovery integration bad-first/good-next/no-good+valid-source fallback/explicit refresh; retain test_new_operation_rejects_changed_reused_original_before_new_fee, same-run pin/publication corruption and unknown-cost ledger controls

findings.title: 同unit一个未知语法子句可否决另一个独立已证资料子句
findings.condition: one prepared statement scope contains known independent source material and another clause with unavailable/scope_limit grammar; uncertainty return precedes existing independent support reuse
findings.effect: entire native unit passage assessment_complete=False/relevant=False, then admission false; partial source annotation may withhold usable independent clause with it
findings.root_cause: processing completeness and supported material availability aggregated into one per-unit bool instead of preserving independent local support scope
findings.change: first add same-native-unit mixed control using existing prepared clause keys; retain independently supported subclause/context closure while deferring unknown clause and marking source partial; reuse prepared observations, no unknown -> fact promotion and no new state/permission system
findings.tests: existing test_one_deferred_scope_does_not_stop_an_independent_healthy_scope covers two different units only; add same-unit known typed clause+missing-resource generic clause, inverse order, positive/negative condition attachment and shared context. Not executed in this read-only audit; do not claim public-selector reproduction.

findings.title: VerifiedContent上层再次整buffer SHA且再次查metadata
findings.condition: public reader has just read/hashes actual bytes and returns same immutable VerifiedContent; handler guard recomputes sha256(opened.data), then describe_version queries same identity separately
findings.effect: source select and verify each pay redundant full-buffer digest plus duplicate metadata observation; old read-policy string is already diagnostic and is not needed as a second permission
findings.root_cause: consumer does not fully rely on lower verified-source port responsibility; defensive unit fakes encouraged repeated verification
findings.change: retain exact per-operation real reader byte SHA/current state/root/path resolution once; thin upper checks compare requested ref/returned identity only; use existing open_described_version where source and metadata both needed. No long-lived cross-request trust cache; changed originals must still fail actual reader
findings.tests: move wrong-byte/mtime/source-change tests to real reader boundary; handler tests retain wrong ref/ID/subject/metadata rejection and assert one reader hash/description per operation. Do not change as-of selection or event-number proof.

findings.title: 几何导航hint有多套任意固定天花板且整份丢弃
findings.condition: otherwise valid native outline >4096 rows / level>32 / title>4096, or explicit requested max_pages/max_requests>64 or >64 same-page window keys
findings.effect: valid hint set becomes empty/partial, caller limits silently clamped to64, page request rejected because key count not physical ambiguity; original shared WorkBudget already exists
findings.root_cause: optional navigation format bounds and local constants duplicate work/request allocation owner; these caps do not prevent native get_toc allocation (already occurred upstream)
findings.change: consolidate processing under same WorkBudget + explicit request/page allocation; stream iterative stack and preserve independently valid navigation; remove silent clamp/additive hard ceilings. Keep malformed hierarchy/page destinations and physical ambiguity negative controls; do not guess page/ancestor when evidence truly absent
findings.tests: migrate test_limits_cannot_raise_native_hard_ceiling/test_large_outline_bounded_before_iteration to explicit budget depletion and valid large/deep outline preserved; retain invalid parent jump/page order/shared-page conflicts. Do not simply delete all geometry validation.
